sourceText:
Quick Honey Mithai
By: Usha Chowdhary Gupta
Published: Monday, December 6, 2010 - 8:50pm

Ingredients




1 tablespoon Honey,
1 tablespoon Cocoa Powder,
1 tablespoon Chocolate Powder,
1 tablespoon  Butter,
2 Cookies Moulds,
1 tablespoon Raisins (soaked and cut),
1 tablespoon Almonds flakes or cut thinly,
2 Chocolate flavored cream Biscuit,
A dot or a drop of Butter

Preparation

1 Mix together honey, cocoa powder, butter, 2 Chocolate powder. Make flakes of almonds and cut the 3 Soaked raisins. In a bowl crush the biscuits well ,add the raisins and almond flakes. Grease the cookies moulds, at the base set the biscuit mixture, press well. On this spread the chocolate mixture. Set in fridge , de mould and serve.
